subject.title: [codex] acknowledge terminal Gmail OAuth watch failures

question: Should Gmail watch acknowledge an unrecoverable OAuth refresh failure after durably recording recovery state, rather than continue Pub/Sub redelivery until an operator reauthenticates?
rationale: This is an intentional delivery-policy tradeoff: it prevents unbounded retry storms but makes reauthentication plus watch renewal the required operator recovery path.

options.title: Accept durable recovery acknowledgement
options.body: Merge the proposed contract, using the preserved cursor and immediate watch-registration notification to catch up after reauthentication.

options.title: Keep retrying terminal OAuth failures
options.body: Retain the existing Pub/Sub retry behavior until a different recovery mechanism is designed, accepting repeated failures during invalid credentials.

recommendation.title: Accept durable recovery acknowledgement
recommendation.body: Merge the proposed contract, using the preserved cursor and immediate watch-registration notification to catch up after reauthentication.

likelyOwner.reason: The active head and recovery-state implementation are authored by steipete, making this the strongest available routing signal for the Gmail-watch contract.
